evidence: Source-level floor safeguards are present, but empirical configured-judge floor behavior is unmeasured. Frozen task tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23-27 requires usable workspace plus a newly chosen authored marker in actual preview and console after Run, explicitly excluding editor-only or hardcoded sample evidence. Blank/static/seed-copy/keyword-only pages and a submission refusing all actions cannot meet that positive control. tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29 additionally requires a new normal-UI save, observed write, exact identity/title/filename/source retrieval from a genuinely clean context, and another retrieval after reload; a no-op POST plus localStorage mock cannot meet it. tests/test.sh:212-225 scores gates before running scored dimensions and exits on a failed gate. tests/tools/score.py:40-48 requires both gate values >0 and functional >0.05; failed gates discard supplied scored values. Polish prompt:13-21 hard-zeros a failed local prerequisite; Visual prompt:33-50 assigns raw anchor 1, normalized to zero; Functional prompt:5 restates its zeroing gate. The independent local run row39-scorer-controls/RESULTS.json (SHA256 0c11faa87d74f433dcad74c56ad0c9ea9ae4aa4ec4e9cc5ce8fda340f8cea93e) executed the exact frozen scorer: render failure, constraints failure, both failures, functional 0, and functional 0.05 each yielded reward 0 despite supplied maximum presentation scores; functional 0.050001 with maximum presentation yielded 0.43 and all-max yielded 1. These are synthetic inputs, not judged app scores. All 13 indexed raw MCP gate artifacts and all 50 source-binding hashes were independently verified. The raw row29-mcp-probe/observations.json (SHA256 ba10bfd001272d5f0db2f2d7cfdf6fadf6e6652dd1fe2b1d6fe49aff5067b181) shows the golden authored marker rendered/logged, POST status 201, clean storage null, and matching fresh/reloaded source; its provider_invoked and configured_judge_invoked are false. Conforming-alternative challenge: a working app using CDN assets, different labels/routes, server-rendered library records, an initially empty library or no Auto-run control in an otherwise working manual flow is expressly accommodated by instruction.md, constraints criterion:27, app_context.md:16-20 and all gate wording. No source-level false failure was identified for those alternatives. The current evidence index explicitly lists Empirical configured reward floor/ranking as not measured. No configured judge has graded the requested blank/static/mock/seed-copy/stuffing/refusal matrix in the supplied artifacts; source reasoning, synthetic scoring and golden gate feasibility cannot establish those scores. This missing measurement remains a risk.
counterexample: Unmeasured adversarial candidate to include in the weak-app matrix: a plausible editor UI with real basic save/read persistence, but a fake Run handler that recognizes literal document.body.textContent and console.log strings and echoes them without executing general JavaScript. It may satisfy a literal authored-marker probe and earn independently valid editor/storage credit above the 0.05 functional floor. A computed marker or real arithmetic/control-flow witness can distinguish it. This is a reasoned challenge, not a confirmed app or measured reward; the supplied evidence does not resolve it.
suggested_fix: Obtain authorized, hash-bound configured-judge runs of blank, static, seed-copy, keyword-stuffed, refusing, browser-storage-only and fake-execution fixtures plus a working conforming control; preserve per-gate and final rewards and fix any demonstrated bypass in a new candidate without changing shared reward policy.
